name: System email plumbing
summary: Only enough to deliver verification and password reset. No templating, no deliverability configuration, no tracking, no inbound routing. Superseded by comms.email, which adds all of it.

requires.reason: OutboundMessage is a persisted entity holding personal data, with declared export and deletion handlers; it must go through the repository layer.
Delivery is asynchronous so a request never blocks on an SMTP round trip.

owns.name: OutboundMessage
owns.description: Delivery record. Body is not retained beyond the send window.

exposes.name: send
exposes.description: comms.email must satisfy this signature to upgrade this capability.

external.purpose: Deliver verification and password reset messages.

credentials.name: MAIL_DSN
credentials.description: Connection string or provider API key for outbound mail.

smoke.name: verification email is dispatched
smoke.asserts: registering a user enqueues exactly one verification message

templates.description: Binds the environment variable schema. Reads values from the environment at runtime; never contains them.
